content: Isaye Nikoḍomasore šikar
Heṛe Forošir ekzon manuš aššil, zar nam Nikoḍomas, Ihudi okkolor ek neta.

Ekdin raitta hibaye Isar hãse aiyore hodde, "Rabbi, ãra zani õne ekzon šikkadoya, ze Allar hãsottu aiššo. Kiyollahoile õne ze sinnor ham okkol zin goijjo, hin Allah fũwati no takile honokiye gori no fare."
Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũware soiyi hoir, noya gori zormo no oile, honokiye Allar raijjo deki no faribo."

content: Nikoḍomase hibare hodde, "Manuš ekzon bura oile kengori zormo oi faribo? Hite ki dusora bar mar ferõt uwafes firizaiyore zormo oi faribo?"
Zuwabe Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũware soiyi hoir, zodi hono kiye fani edde Pak Ruhuttu zormo no o, hite Allar raijjot goli no fare.
Hiyan ziyan gustor zormo oiye, oilde gusto, ar hiyan ziyan Ruhor zormo oiye, oilde ruh.
Ãi ze tũware hoilam, 'Tũwarattu hameka noya gori zormo owa foribo,' hiyanot ammuwak no oiyo.
Boyar ze mikka baito sa he mikka ba. Tũwara hinor abas funo, kintu ei boyar hontu aiye edde hon mikka za hiyan tũwara hoi no faro. Pak Ruhor zormo owa o hendilla."

content: Nikoḍomase hodde, "En kengori oi faribo?"
Hetunot Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũi Israilor šikkadoya oi bade ei ziniš okkol kissu no buzo kiya?
Ãi tũware soiyi hoir, ãra ziyan zani ãra hiyan hoi, ar zin deki hinor babute goba di, kintu tũwara ãrar goba no goso.
Ãi duniyaibi zinišor babute hoidde hin zodi biššaš no goror, henot behostor zinišor babute hoile ken gori biššaš goriba?
Ze behostottu lami aišše he Adomor Fut sara ar honokiye honodin behostot no uṛe.
Ar Musa nobiye zendilla bošoti sara elehat hafore uwore tullil, hendilla Adomor Futore o tuli lowa oibo,
zene fottikiye ze hibare biššaš gore hite akeri zibon fa."

content: Kiyollahoile Allaye duniyaire eto beši ador goijje ze, hibar he lehar ek Futore diye, zene, ze kiye hibar uwore biššaš ane hite dongšo no o, bolke akeri zibon fa.
Kiyollahoile Allaye hibar Futore defeṛaiyede duniyair bisar goribolla no, bolke duniyaiye zene hibar duwara uddar fa.
Hite ze hibare biššaš gorer, hitar bisar gora no oibo, kintu hite ze biššaš no gorer hitar bisar ehon loti oigiyegoi, kiyollahoile hite Allar šude lehar Futor namot biššaš no ane.
Ar iyan oilde bisar: Nur duniyait aišše, ar manuš okkole nurottuwaro andarore beši muhabbot goijje, kiyollahoile hitarar ham aššil horaf.
Kiyollahoile fottikiye ze horaf ham gorer, hitara nurore hingša gorer, ar nuror ḍake nu aiye, zene hitar horaf ham forhaš oi no zagoi
Kintu hite ze soyit soler, hite nuror hãse aiye, toi zene hitar hamgun Allar issa mozin gora oiyede hiyan foriškar deha za.
Yahyaye Isar babute goba der
In okkol bade, Isa edde hibar sahabi okkol Ehudiya elehat aišše, ar hiba heṛe kissu din hitarar fũwati taikke, edde torikotor gusol diye.
Ehon, Yahyaye o Salimor hãsa hãsi Aenonot, torikotor gusol diyat aššil, kiyollahoile heṛe beši fani aššil, ar manuš okkol heṛe aiyore torikotor gusol lowat aššil.
(In aššilde Yahyare ziyolot dibar age.)
Hẽtte Ihudi rosomi pak safor babute Yahyar šagirit okkol loi edde ekzon Ihudi loi barabari uiṭṭe.
Bade hitara Yahyar hãse aiyore hodde, "Rabbi, ze Zordanor ofarot õnor fũwati aššil, edde zar babute õne goba dila, so, hibaye torikotor gusol der, ar beggune hibar hãse zar."
Yahyaye hodde, "Behostottu diya oiyede no oile ekzon mainše hono kissu fai no fare.
Tũwara nize ãr goba ze ãi hoiyi, 'Ãi Messiyah no, kintu ãre hibar age defeṛa oiye.'
Zar hãse hoinna, hiba oilde dula. Dular bondu, ze tiyaiyore hibar hota funer, hibaye dular abazot beši kušiye anondo gorer; aijja ãttu o hendilla furafuri kuši furon oiye.
Iyan zorulot ehonottu loti hibattu bara foribo, ãttu šoṛo owa foribo."
Ze uwottu aiye, hiba beggunor uwore; ze duniyaittu hite duniyair, ar duniyair ekzonor ḍoilla hota ho. Hiba ze behostottu aiye, hiba beggunor uwore.
Hibaye zin deikke edde fuinne hinor goba der, tarfore o honokiye hibar gobare no goser.
Hite ze hibar gobare goser, hiyane sil maijje ze Allah oilde soiyi.
Kiyollahoile hiba zare Allaye defeṛaiye, hibaye Allar kalam hor; kiyollahoile Allaye Ruhure mafiyore no de.
Bafe Futore ador gore edde hár kissure hibar hãtot šebi diye.
Hite ze Futore biššaš gore, hite akeri zibon faiye, kintu hite ze Futore batil gore, hite zibon no dekibo, bolke Allar gozob hitar uwore ase edde takibo.
